Half-day Panama Drumming Experience 





Join the Panama Drumming Experience for an authentic dive into Panamanian folklore led by master percussionist Omar Díaz. From the moment our driver picks you up at the hotel until you’re returned at the end of the session, you’ll participate in a carefully crafted workshop designed for all skill levels, no prior experience required. You’ll learn to master the three essential drums (Repicador, Pujador and Caja) and the fundamental strokes Claro, Queme and Pujo. Under Omar’s expert guidance, you’ll explore vibrant rhythmic patterns such as Cumbia, Corrido and Tambor Norte, and take part in traditional dance accompaniments like the Tamborito, Punto Panameño and Fiesta del Torito Guapo. Along the way, you’ll uncover the cultural significance of each instrument, from the selection of fine woods and artisanal hides to the blending of African and Spanish influences. The experience features detailed explanations, hands-on demonstrations and tailored insights to help you develop your own style and carry the true pulse of Panama with you.



GUIDE: Bilingual guideDURATION: Approximately 2 hours

INCLUDE: Private transfer from/to the hotel

HALF-DAY GEISHA COFFEE EXPERIENCE IN CASCO VIEJO





Experience the soul of Panamanian coffee on an intimate, expert-led sensory journey. Your adventure begins with a tasting of Geisha coffee washed, natural and honey processed, guided by a high-altitude coffee specialist who will reveal how each method teases out the bean’s delicate aromas, silky body and bright acidity. As you savor each cup, you’ll uncover the remarkable story behind this legendary bean, from its mountain origins to its triumphs on the world stage, gaining a newfound appreciation for why Geisha is hailed as one of the finest coffees on earth. To complete the experience, indulge in artisanal desserts crafted with Geisha beans, each perfectly paired to highlight their subtle flavor notes. This thoughtfully curated excursion promises to immerse you fully in Panama’s vibrant coffee culture and leave your senses awakened.



GUIDE: Bilingual guideDURATION: Approximately 2 hours

Medio Dia de Experiencia de Tambor en Panamá 





Vive el folclor panameño de la mano del maestro percusionista Omar Díaz con nuestra Panama Drumming Experience. Desde que el conductor te recoge en el hotel hasta tu regreso al finalizar la sesión, disfrutarás de un taller diseñado para todos los niveles, sin necesidad de experiencia previa. Aprenderás a dominar los tres tambores esenciales—Repicador, Pujador y Caja—y las técnicas de golpe Claro, Queme y Pujo. Bajo la guía experta de Omar, explorarás ritmos vibrantes como Cumbia, Corrido y Tambor Norte, y participarás en acompañamientos de danzas tradicionales como el Tamborito, el Punto Panameño y la Fiesta del Torito Guapo. También descubrirás el trasfondo cultural de cada instrumento, desde la selección de maderas nobles y cueros artesanales hasta la fusión de influencias africanas y españolas. La experiencia incluye explicaciones detalladas, práctica guiada y consejos personalizados para que adoptes tu propio estilo y te lleves contigo el auténtico pulso de Panamá.

HALF-DAY COFFEE TOUR AT FINCA DON PEPE

Pick up at the hotel, private car, to head towards the farm located on the slopes of Volcán Barú, specifically in the Volcancito area (Boquete, Chiriquí); at an altitude of 1,500 to 2,000 meters above sea level. We have 70 hectares of land: 59 for coffee cultivation and 11 for natural

reserve. Our tour begins around the coffee plantations, where we show the different grain varieties that this farm produces: Geishas, Caturra, Catuaí, Pacamara, Bourbon, Typica, Java. You will learn about the life cycle of these plants and why it is considered an organic and environmentally sustainable plantation.

You can visit the area with the equipment where the honey, natural and nafa washing processes are carried out. You can also observe the coffee drying area called "African beds", the drying machines and the warehouses of this farm, where the processes for export are carried out. You

will enjoy a tasting of 8 to 9 coffee varieties, 3 of which are Panamanian Geishas.

HALF DAY CHOCOLATE MAKING CLASS EXPERIENCE 





Immerse yourself in the art of chocolate crafting with a workshop led by a seasoned chocolate specialist. Your journey begins with an introduction to the origins and flavor profiles of premium cacao beans, followed by hands-on roasting, winnowing and grinding to create your own bean-to-bar base. Under expert guidance, you’ll master conching techniques and the tempering process needed for a flawless, glossy finish and silky mouthfeel. Next, you’ll personalize your creation by blending in select ingredients—nuts, spices or dried fruits—before pouring the mix into artisanal molds and adding your own decorative touches. By the end of the session, you’ll walk away with half a kilo of beautifully wrapped bars and a deeper appreciation for the craftsmanship behind every bite.



GUIDE: Bilingual guideDURATION: Approximately 4 hoursINCLUDE: Private transfer from/to the hotel, all materials and a final tasting

IMPORTANT NOTE: Please inform us of any allergies or dietary restrictions at least 48 hours before your session so we can accommodate your needs.





HIKING TO BARU VOLCANO SUMMIT





Enhance your adventure with the opportunity to enjoy the unique view of both oceans

(Pacific and Caribbean on a clear day) and be part of the experience of being at the highest point of elevation in Panama at 3,475 meters above sea level.





The path that takes us to the volcano is 13 km long to the top and returning by the same route. The degree of difficulty of this trail is very high and demanding, requiring great physical

condition. It takes 6 hours of ascent and 5 ½ hours of descent; the estimated time for this tour is 12 to 13 hours, depending on the physical conditions of the participants. The tour includes a

hearty breakfast, refreshing water, and hot coffee, ensuring you are well prepared for this unforgettable journey.

DURATION: 12 to 13 hours approximately

TIME: Pickup between 3:00-3:30 a.m.

INCLUDED: Bilingual Guide, breakfast, water, and hot coffee.

NOTE:

Warm clothing is essential; at the top of the volcano, temperatures can reach very low levels

Trail difficulty: very high.

EXCURSIONS WITH BILINGUAL ENGLISH/SPANISH SPEAKING GUIDE/DRIVER HALF-DAY BIRD WATCHING AT FINCA LERIDA

While going all over the trails of this property, along with an expert guide you will have the opportunity to observe, discover and listen to a great variety of bird species inhabiting the place. And if you are lucky, you might see the mythological Quetzal, since the place is full of aguacatillo trees, its favorite food.

HALF-DAY COFFEE TOUR AT FINCA LERIDA



The coffee and Finca Lerida’s history dates back to the year 1911 when Sir Toleff Mönniche, one of the Norwegian Engineers who worked in the construction and design of the Panama Canal, in 1924 he built his first Coffee Farm.

Later in time, in 1929, he began to export Panamanian coffee to Germany and he made this place a mandatory tourist reference point. The route starts with a walk by the coffee plantations where

their microclimate and variety are essential in order to reach excellence levels.

Afterwards, you will visit the areas where the pulp is removed from coffee cherries; they are dried out and roasted. At the end, there will be a coffee tasting within which its scent, aroma and

character are merged while creating a perfect balance of sweet and bitter tastes and blending.

While going all over the trails of this property, you will walk through the coffee fields, and learn about the coffee production process, its rich history and cultural significance in Panama. FULL-DAY AZUERO FOLKLORE WITH RUM TOUR

Discover during the entire day the culture and folklore of Panama by visiting Azuero and meeting its skillful artisans who have kept their traditions (dating from the time of the conquest) intact.

Particularly, you will be able to see the making-of the so-called polleras, beautiful traditional

dresses worn in Spain during the conquest. Also, you will be able to see the local’s mastery while manufacturing the eye-catching paper mache masks, which emulate bright-colored demons or animals; generally used in traditional festivities such as Corpus Christi and Diablicos Sucios.

Likewise, you will discover the secrets of drums, the main instrument of Panamanian traditional music.

The tour continues at San Isidro Farm, where the best Panamanian rum is produced: Ron Abuelo. Visiting along the plantations, you will see the different stages of the production process: the juice extraction, its fermentation and its distillation. Later on, you will see the rum maturing process, mostly done in little oak casks until it reaches different commercialized standards: Ron Abuelo Añejo, Ron Abuelo (7 Year Old Rum) and Ron Abuelo (12 Year Old Rum), and Ron Abuelo Centuria

(30 Year Old Rum) Finally, there will be a tasting of different kinds of rum, through which you will sense their scent, aroma and intensity. The tour includes a typical Panamanian lunch.

DURATION: 8 hours approximately

TIME: 8:30 a.m., subject to confirmation.

INCLUDED: Bilingual guide, transfers from/to the hotel, visits, rum tasting and lunch with drinks.

IMPORTANT: Tours and visits are subject to change depending on the weather or different schedules.

HALF-DAY SEA TURTLE WATCHING ECO TOUR (NIGHT)

The tour starts in the afternoon with the shuttle service to the Cañas pier where you will board a powerboat which will take you to Isla Cañas. From July to January, its fourteen kilometers [8.6992 miles] seashore receives thousands of turtles, predominantly, olive ridley sea turtles that arrive to deposit their eggs. An interesting sustainable tourism project is being undertaken on the island. It arose after turtle’s eggs production and commercialization for human consumption were

forbidden; that represented, along with fishing, the sole income source of the local population.

Upon your arrival to the island, dinner will be served, prepared by local ladies. Afterwards, aboard a cart pulled by horses, you will reach the beach where you will see in detail turtles depositing

their eggs or turtles coming out of their shells. You should pay close attention to the guide’s indications to disturb the turtles as little as possible. Finally, return to the Hotel.

DURATION: 4 hours approximately

TIME: 4:30 p.m. (night-time tour), subject to confirmation. INCLUDED: Bilingual guide, transfer from/to the hotel, visits, dinner. NOTE:

It is offered from late July to October only. Probabilities to watch turtles are high; however, they are not guaranteed.

IMPORTANT: Tours and visits are subject to change depending on the weather or different schedules.

OUTFIT RECOMMENDATION: Comfortable clothes and shoes (for a walk on the beach), long pants, repellent and raincoat.





FULL-DAY IGUANA ISLAND SNORKEL & BEACH TOUR WITH LUNCH

The tour starts with the shuttle service to Playa El Arenal, located in the colorful small town of Pedasí where you will board a powerboat, which will take you to Isla Iguana, 8 kilometers away

from the coast. The Isla Iguana Wildlife Refuge is the habitat of a vast colony of man-of-war birds, pelicans, woodcocks, very colorful crabs and green iguanas. This destination is a real paradise for sea lovers. It has white-sand beaches, crystalline waters, and a wonderful barrier reef. You will go



on a walk along the pathway joining the beaches of El Faro and El Cirial which have lush flora and fauna.

Immediately afterwards, you will discover the wonderful submarine world by exploring the area in a guided snorkeling tour. Some snacks (water, a sandwich and biscuits) will be offered during the tour and you will have some relaxing time at the beach. Return to Pedasí, lunch and finally transfer to the hotel.

FULL-DAY WHALE WATCHING & IGUANA ISLAND ECO TOUR (W/LUNCH) (ONLY FROM JULY TO OCTOBER)

The tour invites you to feel the excitement of contemplating closely huge whales that emerge from the sea and surround Isla Iguana. From late July to October, warm waters draw humpback

whales and other whale species down; they migrate from cold waters for breeding. You should not miss this authentic adventure which gets you close to the cetaceans.

The tour starts with the shuttle service to Playa El Arenal, located in the colorful small town of Pedasí where you will set sail in a powerboat to find those sea giants. The guide and the captain have prepared themselves very well to give you the opportunity to watch whales, especially for

those who think that animals’ protection and safety is a priority. Snack time (water, a sandwich and biscuits) during the tour and some relaxing time at the beach. Finally, you will return to the Hotel.

DURATION: 8 hours approximately

TIME: 6:45 am, subject to confirmation.

INCLUDED: Bilingual guide, transfers from/to the hotel, visits, snorkeling equipment, snack and lunch.

It is offered from late July to October. Probabilities to watch whales are high; however, they are not guaranteed.

FULL-DAY VENAO ECO TOUR WITH LUNCH

The Azuero peninsula is perfect to discover and enjoy the magnificent mountain landscapes and the forests filled with beautiful vegetation and plenty of fauna. It has an amazing pacific coast with protected marine parks, barrier reefs and distant dream beaches.

shore perfect for surfing, where you will spend the day relaxing on golden sands, clear blue waters and surrounded by lush vegetation.

BOCA CHICA

TOURS BOCA CHICA DESDE HOTEL BOCAS DEL MAR HUMPBACK WHALE WATCHING - (LATE JULY TO OCTOBER)

Embark on this adventure and discover idyllic beaches with crystal-clear waters on this mini cruise through the islands. During this tour, from July to October, you can observe the majestic humpback whales, sometimes accompanied by their calves. Humpback whales travel great distances from the cold waters of Antarctica to the warm waters of the Panamanian Pacific. These animals are known for their impressive jumps and complex songs that can last up to 20 minutes.

We will depart from the hotel dock towards Chiriquí National Park for whale watching. Afterwards, you can enjoy some time on the beach where you can relax on one or two beautiful tropical islands and take a gentle boat ride between the islands.

TOUR CASCADA KIKI - W/ LUNCH

Connect with nature on a full-day excursion where you can discover the beautiful landscape of the Ngäbe region. The tour begins with a guided trip and transportation to the mountains. In the region, you will take a scenic ride around the area in a 4x4 vehicle that we will be provided. Then, the descent will be on foot along the trail next to one of the most majestic waterfalls in Panama, the Kiki Waterfall.

The hike takes approximately 20 minutes and is accompanied by beautiful views and, if you wish, a refreshing swim! The trail requires a medium to medium/good physical condition. Additionally, if you prefer, you can walk on Boca Brava Island in front of the hotel. It includes a traditional lunch in the Ngäbe region.

DURATION: 7 hours approximately; including 1h15 trip approximately

TIME: Departure at 8:00 a.m.

INCLUDED: Bilingual guide onsite, transfer, 4x4 vehicle, and lunch in the Ngäbe community

FULL-DAY TOUR DOLPHYN BAY, CORAL CAY & RED FROG BEACH - W/BOX LUNCH

Discover the different shades and tones of the fascinating Bocas del Toro archipelago with this day trip complete that invites you to appreciate its beautiful beaches hidden among the lush

vegetation of some of its islands, to come across the groups of mangroves and its characteristic and striking marine life, and to marvel at the attractive atolls of white sand and crystal-clear waters, surrounded by coral barriers. A true underwater paradise ideal for diving and practicing surface diving.

The route includes a stop at the Bocatoritos Lagoon (also known as Dolphin Bay) where you can observe, with a little luck, the dancing dolphins around the boats. Next, you will visit Coral Cay, where you can practice snorkeling and admire its countless and varied colorful fish that hide

among the coral reefs. At the end of the tour, you will be transferred to one of the most beautiful beaches of the archipelago, Red Frog Beach. An extensive strip of golden sand that gives way to



the lush vegetation of the island and which owes its name to the tiny poisonous red frog that lives there.

DURATION: 8 hours approximately

INCLUDED: Entrance to the park, snorkeling equipment and light food (chicken wrap, fruit, water and soft drinks).

Discover different shades and tones of the fascinating Bocas del Toro Archipelago with this daylong tour. It invites you to appreciate its beautiful beaches hidden within the lush vegetation of some of its islands; to come across groups of mangroves and its characteristic and flashy marine

life; and to be amazed by attractive white-sand and crystalline-water atolls surrounded by barrier reefs. This is a true submarine paradise, ideal for diving and snorkeling. The tour will stop at

Laguna de Bocatoritos where you will be able to watch (if you are lucky!) dolphins that dance around boats.

Forthwith, you will visit Coral Cay. Here, you will be able to go snorkeling, and have regard for countless and varied color fish that hide among coral reefs. Later on, you will be able to relax at

the attractive beach of Zapatilla Cays, two of the most beautiful islands of the archipelago, located within the boundaries of Isla Bastimentos National Marine Park. This area offers dreamy beaches, crystalline waters, and magnificent sea beds with splendid coral reefs full of fish including: the angel fish, butterflyfish, parrotfish, moray eel and jewfish, in addition to lobsters and crabs.

FULL DAY TOUR SNAIL POINT, STARFISH BEACH, BIRD ISLAND AND DRAGO BEACH - W/BOX LUNCH

Embark on a full-day adventure exploring Snail Point, Starfish Beach, and Bird Island.

Our journey begins by discovering the captivating Snail Point, also known as Punta Culebra Nature Center; you will dive into several marine exhibits showcasing the rich biodiversity of Panama’s coastal waters and have the opportunity to observe various marine species, including colorful fish, sea turtles, and fascinating invertebrates.

At Starfish Beach it’s the next stop. Immerse yourself in the crystal-clear waters and discover the breathtaking beauty of countless starfish dotting the sandy shores. This idyllic spot is perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and marveling at the wonders beneath the sea. Next, we set sail for Bird Island, a haven for avian enthusiasts. HALF-DAY CASCO ANTIGUO & PANAMA LA VIEJA

The tour starts with a visit to the Old Quarter of Panama City, the historic center of San Felipe, that was declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 1997 thanks to its eclectic fusion of colonial, neoclassic and French architecture. This stop includes a walk along the streets, squares and gravel roads and gives you the opportunity to visit and discover the most emblematic colonial buildings, churches and palaces.





Then it will be time to visit the Ruins of Panama Vieja, the first settlement of the XVI Century at the outskirts of the city, founded in 1519 by Spanish conquistador Pedro Arias Dávila. Panama Vieja was an important stopover for gold and silver en route from South America to Spain, today, it is a fascinating archaeological site that offers a glimpse into the early colonial history of the region.



Wander among the ancient ruins and uncover the tales of its storied past and well-preserved ruins of the original city: Cathedral Tower, which provides panoramic views of the surrounding area.

Convent of the Conception, that reflects the religious and cultural importance of the city during the colonial era; Casa Alarcón, showcasing the architectural style and urban planning of the time; and, the ruins of Hospital de San Juan de Dios are an insight into the healthcare practices of the 16th and 17th centuries.

HALF-DAY SPECIAL FORTALEZA WALKING CASCO TOUR AT SUNSET



The walk starts at Plaza Herrera, in front of the luxurious American Trade Hotel, which was previously the base for the criminal group Ciudad de Dios. The hotel’s structure was known as

Grayskull, the imaginary castle of the 80’s TV show He-man. Next to the internal stairways, walls are decorated with graffiti images that used to cover the interior of the building at the time.

Under the catch phrase “We used to rob tourists before, now we offer them tours”, a group of former gangsters from the fearsome criminal group known as Ciudad de Dios [City of God] tell tourists their story during a walk along the streets of the historic center. These young men

participate in a non-profit private organization that rehabilitated approximately 40 criminals who belonged to the criminal groups named Hot boys, La Terraza and Ciudad de Dios [The Terrace and City of God], and it has helped them rejoin society.

During the walk, they will tell you stories and talk about those violent years while describing

important buildings, and going over forgotten footways that have not been restructured between Calle 9 [9th Street] and Calle 13 [13th Street]. The walk ends in Calle 11 [11th Street], rebaptized under the name of Callejón Fortaleza [Fortaleza Alley], a little dead-end street the criminal group used to escape from the police, and that nowadays it is a tourist attraction with some local food places. The smiles, commitment and kindness of these young men will make you doubt their dark past, and even more, when they state that: “This is actually real life and not the one we had before”; a phrase that shows their enormous will to change.

HALF - DAY PANAMA DRUMMING EXPERIENCE

Join the Panama Drumming Experience for an authentic dive into Panamanian folklore led by master percussionist Omar Díaz. From the moment our driver picks you up at the hotel until you’re returned at the end of the session, you’ll participate in a carefully crafted workshop designed for all skill levels, no prior experience required. You’ll learn to master the three essential drums (Repicador, Pujador and Caja) and the fundamental strokes Claro, Queme and Pujo. Under Omar’s expert guidance, you’ll explore vibrant rhythmic patterns such as Cumbia, Corrido and Tambor Norte, and take part in traditional dance accompaniments like the Tamborito, Punto Panameño and Fiesta del Torito Guapo. Along the way, you’ll uncover the cultural significance of each instrument, from the selection of fine woods and artisanal hides to the blending of African and Spanish influences. The experience features detailed explanations, hands-on demonstrations and tailored insights to help you develop your own style and carry the true pulse of Panama with you.

HALF-DAY METROPOLITAN NATIONAL PARK TOUR

The trip starts with the transfer service to the Metropolitan Natural Park, where you will go for a walk of around two hours through trails from where the park’s incredible fauna and flora can be

seen. The park forms the amazing Mesoamerican Biological Corridor along with Camino de Cruces and Sovereignty National Park.

The Park shelters one of the last refugees of dry tropical forest where a great quantity of birds live (more than 250 species): the curious blue-crowned motmot; the club-winged manakin, that sings while making wing sounds in order attract a mate; the sympathetic keel-billed toucan, with a yellow chest. There are also some sloths, coatis, monkeys, iguanas, anteaters, morpho butterflies and extraordinary orchids. Furthermore, the parks’ trails offer spectacular views of the city and

the gulf.

TIME: Preferably, early in the morning in order to observe the fauna.

HALF-DAY SOBERANIA NATIONAL PARK

Leaving the hotel early in the morning, we will go to Soberania National Park—which is 40 minutes away from the city— in order to get into the trail of Camino de Cruces, which was built in 1527 by the Spanish Crown. It began in Old Panama and went towards the sales port of Cruces on the shore of Chagres River, where a great amount of gold coming from Central and South America was transported.

During the tour, it is possible to see in detail the great variety of flora in this secondary rain forest which serves as a bride to birds that travel to escape from winter and as a shelter for the most

diverse fauna living among bushes, from monkeys, snakes, spiders, to anteaters and other species.

HALF-DAY SOBERANIA NATIONAL PARK & GATUN EXPEDITION

Your adventure begins with a scenic transfer to Soberanía National Park, a protected area that's part of the Panama Canal watershed. As you delve into the park's lush rainforests and diverse

ecosystems, you'll have the opportunity to spot an incredible variety of wildlife, including colorful tropical birds, monkeys and exotic plants. Our experienced guides will lead you through the park's trails, providing insights into the rich biodiversity and natural history of this incredible environment.





After your immersive experience in Soberanía National Park, the tour continues to the magnificent Gatun Lake. This artificial lake—created as part of the Panama Canal—is surrounded by dense

tropical rainforest and serves as a vital waterway for international trade. As you journey across Gatun Lake, you'll be mesmerized by its serene waters and the chance to observe wildlife like crocodiles, monkeys and various bird species.

HALF-DAY GATUN EXPEDITION W/LUNCH

Your journey starts with a visit to Gatun Lake, a vast and serene expanse that was once the largest artificial lake in the world. This expansive freshwater lake was created in the early 20th



century by damming the Chagres River, flooding the surrounding valley, and submerging entire

villages and forests. Today, Gatun Lake is not only a vital transit route for ships navigating the canal, but also a breathtaking destination for ecotourism and outdoor adventures.





As you embark on this excursion, you'll have the opportunity to observe diverse wildlife, including monkeys, vibrant butterflies, graceful herons, and even turtles, all against the backdrop of the

magnificent jungle. The serene waters and picturesque landscapes provide a perfect backdrop for nature photography and wildlife observation. Gatun Lake offers an unforgettable experience in the heart of Central America. Lunch will be provided during the tour.

HALF-DAY PARTIAL CANAL TRANSIT W/TRANSFERS & LUNCH

Feel the excitement of traversing a part of the canal to observe the current operation of the locks, which enable ships to pass through the canal from the Pacific Ocean to the Caribbean Sea. The tour begins with a transfer to the modern Flamenco International Marina where you will set sail towards the entrance of the canal.

On the boat, you will enjoy a panoramic view of the city, the Bridge of the Americas, and the

spectacular gulf dotted with numerous ships waiting to pass through the canal. Each ship must be secured with mooring lines to be towed by electric locomotives called mules that move on parallel rails to keep the ships aligned. In a few minutes, the water will reach the set level, and the lock will open on the stem side, allowing the ship to pass to the next basin.

The journey continues on Lake Miraflores until the Pedro Miguel locks, where the level rises

another 9 meters. Then, the canal narrows, and the ship will continue under the Centennial Bridge until it reaches the famous Gaillard Cut or Culebra Cut, known for its winding curves, where the Chagres River converges. The tour ends in Gamboa, where you will return to the hotel. Lunch is included.

TIME: To be confirmed one day before.

INCLUDED: Bilingual guide on the boat. Private transfer to/from the hotel, lunch with a non- alcoholic drink.
